menus.name: Moments menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner. Also in eight courses (CHF 205, pairing CHF 88) or six (CHF 175, pairing CHF 79). Other pairings for nine courses: Swiss wines CHF 140, 'Pépites' CHF 195, wine and alcohol-free mix CHF 89, alcohol-free CHF 79. Optional supplements: partridge CHF 25, lièvre à la royale CHF 25 or CHF 55. Vegetarian version on request.

menus.name: Déjeuner lunch menu
menus.note: Wednesday to Friday lunch only; changes weekly. Five courses CHF 105. Vegetarian version on request.

alsoTry.name: Le Petit Pérolles
alsoTry.note: The house brasserie: dish of the day CHF 24 (three courses CHF 36) Wednesday to Friday lunch, plus an à la carte menu; open Wednesday to Saturday.

bookingOpens: Online through Libro on the restaurant's reservation page, or by phone.
groups: Business meals, team outings, weddings and birthdays are arranged through the contact form on the 'Réunions et célébrations' page.
